Hi Jane / SecOps 

Quick technical answers and what we can commit to for the pilot:

1) SOC 2 status
- Redwood Inference maintains SOC 2 Type II (security + availability)  most recent assessment completed 2027-11-15. Public summary + report access link: https://redwoodinference.com/security/soc2-type2-2027.pdf

2) BAA availability and eligible deployment modes
- We provide a BAA for Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) and Redwood Private (VPC and on-prem) deployments.
- Standard hosted multi-tenant API (self-serve) is NOT eligible for PHI/BAA-covered use in our standard offering.
- For enterprise-hosted agreements (customer-dedicated hosted instances) we can discuss BAA coverage on a case-by-case basis  please flag if you'd like to explore that option.

3) PHI handling boundaries and retention/logging
- Dedicated and Private: PHI remains within the customer's dedicated tenant; we optionally disable long-term prompt/response logging for BAA customers. KV/prefix caches are scoped to the dedicated instance and not shared.
- By default we retain short-term inference telemetry for 24 hrs to support troubleshooting; for BAA customers we offer configurable retention policies (including no persistent storage of prompts/responses) and audit logs exported to the customer's SIEM.
- Embeddings / model outputs: if you choose to store embeddings in our managed embedding store, those are treated as customer data under the BAA and subject to retention controls. We recommend customers use their own embedding store in dedicated/private deployments for tighter control.

4) Encryption & KMS
- TLS 1.2+ in transit; AES-256 at rest.
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys (Bring Your Own Key) for Dedicated and Private deployments (HSM/KMS integrations available). For standard hosted API we use Redwood-managed keys.

5) Data residency
- We can restrict processing to US regions for Dedicated/Private deployments; for Private on-prem deployments you control physical locality.

6) Next steps & timeline
- I'll start working through your attached vendor questionnaire today and aim to return an initial completed copy in ~3 business days.
- I'll attach the SOC 2 summary and BAA template to the questionnaire response.
- Monica can run the technical deep-dive  Tue/Wed afternoon ET works for us; Marissa can coordinate scheduling.

Attachments to follow: Redwood_Security_Pack.pdf (includes SOC 2 summary, network diagrams, BAA template)

Let me know if you need anything more granular (e.g., specific network CIDR examples, firewall policies, or a sample KMS config).

Thanks,
David Kim
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
